CustomField.label: Severity Contributors JSON
CustomField.description: JSON-serialized List<OI_HealthScoreContributor> — every signal OI_HealthScoringEngine combined into Score__c/Severity__c, with each one's magnitude, confidence, impact, exposure, and resulting contribution. Powers the finding drawer's "why this severity" breakdown. Refreshed on every re-scan alongside the other evidence fields, never treated as lifecycle data.
